results.insight: Revenue grew 15.8% YoY and 15.9% QoQ, while PAT rose 27.2% YoY and 19.3% QoQ, driven by strong execution across projects and manufacturing portfolios.
results.notes: PAT is total net profit after tax including share of joint ventures/associates and before non-controlling interest. Q1 FY27 EBITDA is derived by subtracting Q2 FY27 EBITDA (₹6,845 crore) from H1 FY27 EBITDA (₹12,961 crore).

people.name: Dr. C Jayakumar
people.role: Senior Vice President & Head - Corporate Human Resources
people.bio: Dr. C. Jayakumar is a distinguished HR leader with over 38 years of rich and diverse experience in strategic HRM & organizational transformation. As the CHRO of L&T Ltd., he has played a pivotal role in shaping the people agenda of one of India's top conglomerates. An alumnus of LBS, Dr. Jayakumar holds a doctorate in leadership, certification in executive coaching from CFI.

people.name: Mr. Suresh Kumar Narang
people.role: Senior Vice President & IC Head - CarbonLite Solutions IC & Chief Executive – LMB
people.bio: Mr. Suresh Kumar Narang, Sr. Vice President & Head – L&T Energy-CarbonLite Solutions, has over four decades of experience across the power sector, spanning thermal power project design, EPC execution, operations, commercial management, coal mining, and consulting. Since joining L&T in 2010, he has led several landmark initiatives, including the execution of India’s first Ultra Supercritical Power Project at Khargone for NTPC. As Chief Executive of Nabha Power Ltd (2021-2026), he transformed the company into one of India’s most efficient supercritical thermal power plants.

people.name: Mr. S Ramkumar
people.role: Senior Vice President & IC Head - Transportation Infrastructure IC
people.bio: Mr. S. Ramkumar is an Electrical Engineer from NIT Durgapur and an alumnus of the London Business School Senior Executive Programme. With over three decades at Larsen & Toubro, he currently heads the Transportation Infrastructure Division, encompassing the Roads, Bridges & Formations (RBF) and Railway Business Groups (RBG).

people.name: Mr. Sriraman T
people.role: Senior Vice President & IC Head - Residential, Commercial Buildings & Factories IC
people.bio: Mr. T. Sriraman joined L&T as a Graduate Engineer Trainee in 1992 and has over 34 years of experience across diverse functions and business verticals within L&T Construction. His areas of expertise include project execution, contracts, procurement, business development, and business strategy.
